a1-anticircular.title: ANTI-CIRCULAR: default prior is a no-op (structural only)
a1-anticircular.imperative: Verify the default prior bakes NO #443 compound magnitude: read the prior/default code path AND independently probe that the default k tracks the data (two different planted k-ladders yield two different default outputs) while only an injected tight prior moves k. Monotone/k>=0/range is OK; a hard-coded SOFT/MED/HARD k value is NOT. Record pass/fail.
a1-anticircular.finding: PASS. Default prior=None: _blend_prior returns values unchanged; _apply_structural applies ONLY monotone PAVA + nonneg (structural). StructuralPrior defaults are empty dicts -> no magnitude. No #443/SOFT/MED/HARD k constants in source (grep clean; only docstring mention saying none used). Independent probe: planting two different k-ladders (A 0.001/0.0025/0.004, B 0.003/0.006/0.009) yields default outputs that TRACK the data (A->0.00104/0.00242/0.00408, B->0.00304/0.00592/0.00908) -> default bakes no fixed magnitude. Injected tight prior moves HARD 0.00104->0.01584. Anti-circular holds.

a4-loo.finding: PASS. _loo_circuit: tr=frame[gp!=g] (held-out circuit EXCLUDED), te=frame[gp==g]; _fit_shared(tr) re-pools base/k/track on training folds only; base_folds/k_folds collect out-of-fold params; k-stability std is across leave-one-circuit-out folds. _oos_residuals predicts held-out circuit with out-of-fold base+slope, fitting ONLY the unknowable per-circuit intercept in-fold (legitimate: intercept is circuit-specific, cannot be borrowed). Genuinely out-of-sample, not self-inclusive.

a6-gtrack.finding: PASS. g_track is a genuine per-circuit slope term: design column X[:,G+C+gi]=Lc where Lc=(cumulative_track_laps centred per gp)/100; distinct from the tyre compound-contrast columns and from the per-circuit intercept. _track_evolution shrinks per-circuit slopes via pool_random_effects (partial pooling, tau=genuine spread).
